preamble: WHEREAS it is necessary to provide for the regulation and control of the recruitment and conditions of service of the Bangladesh Armed Forces; It is hereby enacted as follows:—

sections.title: Short title, extent and commencement

body.text: This Act may be called the Armed Forces (Recruitment and Conditions of Service) Act, 1948.
It extends to [the whole of Bangladesh].
It shall come into force at once.

notes: The words “the whole of Bangladesh” were substituted for the words “all the territories of Pakistan” by section 3 and the Second Schedule of the Bangladesh Laws (Revision and Declaration) Act, 1973 (Act No. VIII of 1973)

sections.title: Power to make rules for recruitment

body.text: The recruitment to the Armed Forces of [Bangladesh] including the Army, the Navy and the Air Force shall be governed by rules framed by the Government.

notes: The word “Bangladesh” was substituted for the word “Pakistan” by section 3 and the Second Schedule of the Bangladesh Laws (Revision and Declaration) Act, 1973 (Act No. VIII of 1973)

sections.title: Power to make rules for conditions of service

body.text: The Government shall make Rules for the regulation and control of the conditions of service as respects pay, leave, pensions and general rights of the services mentioned in section 2.
